recognize_zh: 整片骨髓抹片幾乎都是各階段的顆粒球系細胞（骨髓球、後骨髓球、帶狀核與分葉核嗜中性球），有核紅血球前驅細胞非常少，因此骨髓/紅血球比（M:E ratio）明顯升高。
features: Hypercellular smear dominated by granulocytic cells at all stages of maturation
Abundant myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils with orderly maturation
Very few erythroid precursors (only occasional dark round-nucleus normoblasts), indicating a markedly increased M:E ratio
No increase in blasts evident; no obvious dysplasia at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular with a marked predominance of granulocytic elements showing orderly maturation from myelocytes to segmented neutrophils, with scattered eosinophils. Erythroid precursors are sparse, resulting in a markedly increased myeloid-to-erythroid ratio. Blasts are not increased and no significant dysgranulopoiesis is evident at this magnification. Findings are consistent with granulocytic hyperplasia with increased M:E ratio, which may reflect infection or inflammation, growth factor effect, erythroid suppression, or a myeloproliferative neoplasm; clinical and CBC correlation is required.

ddx.vs: Shows a myelocyte peak with basophilia, eosinophilia and small hypolobated megakaryocytes and requires BCR::ABL1 demonstration.
The increased M:E ratio results from absent erythroid precursors with normal rather than increased granulopoiesis and reticulocytopenia.
Shows predominance of mature segmented neutrophils with peripheral neutrophilia and CSF3R mutation.
Requires at least 20% blasts, often with Auer rods, rather than mostly maturing granulocytes.
